name: v20_s09_revoke_existing_entitlement
branch: Transferred employee requests revocation of legacy sales CRM access; agent inspects active entitlements and revokes synthetic entitlement.
tests: Does the agent inspect current entitlements and successfully revoke the specified active entitlement?
instruction: You are Ian Malcolm (employee ID E09), an analytics consultant who transferred from sales support. You still have active sales_rep access on CRM System (APP-CRM) under entitlement ENT-CRM-09. Ask the IT service desk to look up your active access on APP-CRM and revoke entitlement ENT-CRM-09. If asked for a reason, provide: 'Transferred from sales support project'.

persona.name: Ian Malcolm
persona.initial_message: Hello, I am Ian Malcolm (E09). I recently moved off the sales project and need my legacy sales_rep access on CRM System (APP-CRM) revoked. Could you look up my active access and remove entitlement ENT-CRM-09?
